_comment: Meta-progression, R5-lite (ROGUELITE_REWORK section 9, ruled 2026-09-26: death ends the run; a run-end screen shows run stats, XP and character level; waking at the Throne is an unlock). XP is BANKED THE INSTANT IT IS EARNED -- a death two hours in still counts. Levels are computed from total XP at read time, never stored. Unlocks widen the option pool and never raise numbers (LIVING_WORLD ruling 1); second_wake is the one designer-sanctioned bend, the way carried relics are ROGUELITE section 10's. Every number here is a playtest hypothesis.

deed_xp._comment: Keyed by the deed ids Necromancer.record_deed() writes. Anything not listed pays `default`.

event_xp._comment: Battles won and things brought home. `banked_unit` is per unit of loot deposited at the Throne from a sortie; `relic_banked` is per relic.

run_end_xp._comment: Paid once, when the run ends, however it ends. `per_day` is per full game day survived.

unlocks.name: Second Wake
unlocks.description: Once per run, death still costs everything he carries -- but he wakes at the Throne instead of the run ending.
